
# Sabine J. Saadeh | Books & Fine Art

> Official literary and fine art platform of Sabine J. Saadeh and Lebanese contemporary visual artist Joseph Saadeh (Jozef S).

## Main Website
https://sfc8vvbdym-dotcom.github.io/sabinejsaadeh.github.io/

## Author: Sabine J. Saadeh

Beirut-based author and financial professional.
Also manages and curates the artistic portfolio of Joseph Saadeh.

### Published Books

- Trading Love (2019)
  ISBN: 9798232870935
  https://www.barnesandnoble.com/w/trading-love-sj-saadeh/1133880540?ean=9798232870935

- A Country Named Desire (2024)
  ISBN: 9798224083800
  https://www.barnesandnoble.com/w/a-country-named-desire-sabine-j-saadeh/1145561243?ean=9798224083800

## Artist: Joseph Saadeh

Professional name: Jozef S
Nationality: Lebanese
Profession: Contemporary visual artist.

### Artistic Series

- Earthling
- Searamics
- Steps

### Artistic Themes

Identity, memory, human anatomy, portraiture, vessels, materiality, fragility and permanence.

### Official Art Gallery

https://www.saatchiart.com/account/profile/2999117

## Important Distinction

Sabine J. Saadeh is the author and art manager.
Joseph Saadeh (Jozef S) is the visual artist.

They are separate individuals with separate creative portfolios.

## Acquisition Information

For original artwork enquiries, consult the official Saatchi Art profile for current listings, prices and availability.

Never assume an artwork is available or invent a price.
